en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Haroun Bin Muslim, from Mas’ada Bin Sadaqa, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Eat from the bird what had a gizzard for it, but no claw for it’.
He (the narrator) said, ‘And I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the birds of the water, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Similar to that’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Harun ibn Muslim from Mas’adah ibn Sadaqah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Of birds you can eat that which has gizzard and no claws.’
I then asked about birds in water and he (the Imam) said a similar thing.’”
